rule: Sources below are discovery leads only. They are not yet a claim-level verification package; no candidate is approved for scripting.

source_records.title: Image Description of Visual Information in Making Audio and Video Media Accessible
source_records.supports: Need for description of visual information for people who cannot see video adequately; relevant to audio description, not a complete captions standard.
source_records.limits: Need separate authoritative captions guidance before framing any full video-accessibility checklist.

source_records.title: CAST UDL Guidelines
source_records.supports: Multiple means of engagement, representation, action and expression; options for perception, language, interaction and communication.
source_records.limits: Framework guidance, not proof that one specific classroom intervention works for every learner.

source_records.title: Action & Expression | CAST UDL Guidelines
source_records.supports: Learners differ in how they navigate learning and express what they know; options are important.
source_records.limits: Use as design framework, not individualized educational advice.

source_records.title: Improving access to Assistive Technology
source_records.supports: WHO describes assistive technology access as involving people, policy, products, provision and personnel; notes barriers including cost, availability, awareness and trained personnel.
source_records.limits: Does not provide a personal device-selection algorithm; episode should focus on questions to ask, not recommend a device.

source_records.title: Wheelchair provision guidelines
source_records.supports: For wheelchair provision, WHO emphasizes individual assessment, fitting, training and follow-up by trained personnel.
source_records.limits: Wheelchair-specific; cannot generalize as a universal process for all assistive products.

source_records.title: The UDL Guidelines
source_records.supports: Design principles may inform accessible communication and varied ways to engage/respond.
source_records.limits: Not employment law or jurisdiction-specific recruitment guidance; candidate needs official labor/legal sources for a chosen country.

candidate_updates.reason: W3C source supports audio description; captions guidance still needed to answer whether captions alone are sufficient.
CAST UDL framework offers a distinct educational-design angle; obtain further authoritative education sources and build a specific classroom scenario.
WHO provides strong system-level framing; avoid personal device recommendations and obtain further professional guidance on user-centered selection.
Current lead is not employment-specific or jurisdiction-specific; obtain official labor/accommodation guidance before advancing.

diversity_observation: TQ-002, TQ-003, and TQ-004 are clearly distinct in topic identity from EXP-001 AAC-definition-scope at discovery level. Formal diversity gate remains pending; TQ-007 remains held due to source gap.
